info.name: Clinic Backend - Actual DB Verification
info.description: Runs against a disposable local or staging API/database. Collection-level scripts print request input and response output as [IO] records. Full synthetic bodies require io_log_mode=full; secrets are always redacted.

exec: if (role) { const token = pm.variables.get(`${role}_token`); if (token) pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'Cookie', value: `token=${token}` }); }
const loginRole = /Login patient/i.test(pm.info.requestName) ? 'patient' : /Login staff admin/i.test(pm.info.requestName) ? 'admin' : /Login staff/i.test(pm.info.requestName) ? 'staff' : null;

const scrub = (value) => { if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(scrub); if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return value; return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([key, item]) => [key, (alwaysRedact.test(key) || (mode !== 'full' && clinicalRedact.test(key))) ? '[REDACTED]' : scrub(item)])); };
const parse = (value) => { try { return JSON.parse(value); } catch { return value; } };

console.log('[IO] ' + JSON.stringify({ testId: pm.info.requestName, timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), role: pm.request.headers.get('x-test-role') || 'public', request: { method: pm.request.method, url: pm.request.url.toString(), body: scrub(requestBody) }, response: { status: pm.response.code, body: scrub(parse(responseText)) }, durationMs: pm.response.responseTime }));

if (/Poll automatic prior-auth draft/i.test(pm.info.requestName)) { const status = parse(responseText)?.priorAuthorization?.status; const count = Number(pm.environment.get('draft_poll_count') || 0); if (pm.response.code === 200 && status !== 'drafted' && count < 9) { pm.environment.set('draft_poll_count', String(count + 1)); postman.setNextRequest('Poll automatic prior-auth draft'); } else { pm.environment.unset('draft_poll_count'); if (status === 'drafted') pm.test('draft source is Gemini or fallback', () => pm.expect(['gemini', 'fallback']).to.include(parse(responseText)?.priorAuthorization?.generationSource)); } }

if (result && typeof result === 'object') { if (result.id && /Book appointment/i.test(pm.info.requestName)) pm.environment.set('appointment_id', result.id); if (result.priorAuthorizationId) pm.environment.set('prior_auth_id', result.priorAuthorizationId); if (result.invitation?.id) pm.environment.set('invitation_id', result.invitation.id); if (result.coverage?.id) pm.environment.set('coverage_id', result.coverage.id); if (result.bill?.id) pm.environment.set('bill_id', result.bill.id); }
